familleaux.title: Family Disputes in Morocco
familleaux.text: Family matters such as divorces, child custody, or conflicts between family members are governed by the Family Code (Moudawana). Mediation and conciliation are often favored before resorting to the courts.

accident.title: Road Accident Cases
accident.text: Victims of traffic accidents benefit from a compensation system regulated by Moroccan law, notably the mandatory insurance law. Compensation procedures require rigorous expertise to assess damages.

internationales.title: International Cases
internationales.text: Disputes involving foreign elements, whether concerning family, inheritance, or contracts, require a thorough analysis of conflict of law rules and often international judicial cooperation.

successorales.title: Inheritance Cases
successorales.text: Inheritance settlement in Morocco relies on traditional Muslim law codified in the Moudawana, as well as the Civil Code for some patrimonial aspects. Inheritance conflicts can become complicated when involving assets located abroad.

navbar4.titre: Expertise, Foresight and Defense of Rights in a Global Vision
text: Having acquired undeniable experience in the traditional practice of the legal profession, the founders of the COSTAS Law Firm set themselves the goal of contributing to the modernization of the profession in Morocco and its integration into the global development also experienced by justice and law worldwide.
This vision is our driving force within our professional institutions, in our actions within civil society, and especially in the daily practice of our profession.
For us, the legal profession carries the values of human rights and the active and uncompromising defense of individual and collective rights and the rule of law.

Morocco presents a very attractive economic and social potential. Properly showcasing this potential requires the lawyer to act as a guarantor of the legal and legitimate interests of stakeholders, by contributing to the establishment and respect of the rule of law.

Recognized as specialists in litigation and pre-litigation, we are convinced that our mission of defense and legal advice would not be complete without anticipating, understanding, and managing our clients’ risks.

This is why we build lasting partnerships with them, enabling us to have a broad and comprehensive understanding of their needs and to anticipate the risks they are or will be facing. Our firm’s support allows them to act proactively rather than suffer judicial uncertainty.
We rely on our practice before civil, criminal, and commercial courts, and our litigation experience, to identify and implement solutions tailored to each of our clients’ needs.

Our desire to anticipate in order to defend better naturally leads us to address today’s fundamental legal issues, such as corporate social responsibility, sustainable development, and international criminal law.
As part of this forward-looking approach, we are particularly committed to the open-mindedness and initiatives of all COSTAS Law Firm collaborators.

Their actions and stances on legal issues such as corporate social responsibility, sustainable development, and international criminal law form one of the pillars of the firm, anchoring it in the reality of today’s society.
We put our expertise and personal commitment into every case entrusted to us and commit to being transparent both in the strategy adopted and the method of calculating our fees.

cabinetpresentation.title: COSTAS Law Firm
content: The COSTAS Law Firm, a professional civil company of lawyers, is composed of a team of seven experienced lawyers who have been partners since January 1, 2013.

The legal profession in Morocco, rooted in centuries-old traditions, was first regulated by the Dahir of August 12, 1913, forming the first Civil Procedure Code. The current law regulating the profession dates from October 20, 2008.
The SCPA structure was introduced into Moroccan legislation by Law No. 29/08, promulgated by the Dahir of October 20, 2008. Firms adopting this form of practice are still very rare.
The founding partners of COSTAS practiced individually for a minimum of ten years before forming an SCPA.
From its creation, thanks to its unprecedented combination of expertise, COSTAS quickly established itself as a reference, as acknowledged by professionals.
domains_content: The firm supports its clients through advice, support, assistance, pre-litigation and litigation, in various fields: civil, criminal, and commercial law. Its uniqueness lies in two main features.
The first is its proactive approach, aiming to advise clients on anticipating risks to prevent potential liability.

The second is the diversity of expertise within its team, allowing intervention in business criminal law, corporate and insolvency law, sports law, health law, administrative and tax litigation, renewable energy law, land law, association and public freedoms law, labor law, and more.

The COSTAS Law Firm is driven by strong convictions, particularly its members’ commitment to sustainable development and human rights. Each lawyer sees legal practice as a mission to uphold law, freedoms, and legality, which gives them strength and fulfillment in serving individuals and corporations alike.
